name: random field
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 由空间位置等多个自变量索引的一族随机变量。
usage_overview: 用于表示轨道不平顺或结构参数随位置变化的随机性及空间相关性，也可在相应模型中纳入时间演化和结构层次差异，为不平顺样本构造、动力响应统计及疲劳概率评估提供描述基础。

complete_examples.text: Thereafter, it has become a standard practice to use a random field model to estimate expected values of level crossing and peaks based on a given track length [12] .
Moreover, assuming track irregularity PSD as a joint function of ω and τ, the random field of track irregularities can be equivalently projected to a joint PDF matrix of PSD based on Eq. (14) .

It has been pointed out previously that the train-track-bridge systems are essentially random in nature, especially the track-bridge system, which holds significantly inhomogeneous characteristics in the spatial domain, moreover, the random field of dynamic parameters is constantly evolved corresponding to the cyclic train-track-bridge interactions.
In numerical studies, the random field represented by Eq. (35) is conventionally modelled by MCM that is perhaps the most robust approach in random analysis.

In this work, random field theories, such as expansions of Karhunen– Loe`ve and Polynomial Chaos, are introduced to account for the statistical variability and dependency of track irregularities along track abscissa.
Especially, KLE is a popular method in random field, due to its high efficiency and accuracy.
In Section 4, the random field model is established to character the spatial variability of fastener clips.
